verses.en: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where was a synagogue of the Jews:
verses.pt: Tendo passado por Anfípolis e Apolônia, chegaram a Tessalônica, onde havia uma sinagoga dos judeus.
verses.en_web: Now when they had passed through Amphipolis and Apollonia, they came to Thessalonica, where there was a Jewish synagogue.
verses.en_bbe: Now when they had gone through Amphipolis and Apollonia they came to Thessalonica, where there was a Synagogue of the Jews:

verses.en: And Paul, as his manner was, went in unto them, and three sabbath days reasoned with them out of the scriptures,
verses.pt: Ora, Paulo, segundo o seu costume, foi ter com eles; e por três sábados discutiu com eles as Escrituras,
verses.en_web: Paul, as was his custom, went in to them, and for three Sabbath days reasoned with them from the Scriptures,
verses.en_bbe: And Paul, as he generally did, went in to them, and on three Sabbath days had discussions with them from the holy Writings,

verses.en: Opening and alleging, that Christ must needs have suffered, and risen again from the dead; and that this Jesus, whom I preach unto you, is Christ.
verses.pt: expondo e demonstrando que era necessário que o Cristo padecesse e ressuscitasse dentre os mortos; este Jesus que eu vos anuncio, dizia ele, é o Cristo.
verses.en_web: explaining and demonstrating that the Christ had to suffer and rise again from the dead, and saying, “This Jesus, whom I proclaim to you, is the Christ.”
verses.en_bbe: Saying to them clearly and openly that Christ had to be put to death and come back to life again; and that this Jesus, whom, he said, I am preaching to you, is the Christ.

verses.en: And some of them believed, and consorted with Paul and Silas; and of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and of the chief women not a few.
verses.pt: E alguns deles ficaram persuadidos e aderiram a Paulo e Silas, bem como grande multidão de gregos devotos e não poucas mulheres de posição.
verses.en_web: Some of them were persuaded, and joined Paul and Silas, of the devout Greeks a great multitude, and not a few of the chief women.
verses.en_bbe: And some of them had faith, and were joined to Paul and Silas; and a number of the God-fearing Greeks, and some of the chief women.

verses.en: But the Jews which believed not, moved with envy, took unto them certain lewd fellows of the baser sort, and gathered a company, and set all the city on an uproar, and assaulted the house of Jason, and sought to bring them out to the people.
verses.pt: Mas os judeus, movidos de inveja, tomando consigo alguns homens maus dentre os vadios e ajuntando o povo, alvoroçavam a cidade e, assaltando a casa de Jáson, os procuravam para entregá-los ao povo.
verses.en_web: But the unpersuaded Jews took along some wicked men from the marketplace, and gathering a crowd, set the city in an uproar. Assaulting the house of Jason, they sought to bring them out to the people.
verses.en_bbe: But the Jews, being moved with envy, took with them certain low persons from among the common people, and getting together a great number of people, made an outcry in the town, attacking the house of Jason with the purpose of taking them out to the people.

verses.en: And when they found them not, they drew Jason and certain brethren unto the rulers of the city, crying, These that have turned the world upside down are come hither also;
verses.pt: Porém, não os achando, arrastaram Jáson e alguns irmãos à presença dos magistrados da cidade, clamando: Estes que têm transtornado o mundo chegaram também aqui,
verses.en_web: When they didn’t find them, they dragged Jason and certain brothers before the rulers of the city, crying, “These who have turned the world upside down have come here also,
verses.en_bbe: And when they were not able to get them, they took Jason and some of the brothers by force before the rulers of the town, crying, These men, who have made trouble all over the world have now come here;

verses.en: Whom Jason hath received: and these all do contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, one Jesus.
verses.pt: os quais Jáson acolheu; e todos eles procedem contra os decretos de César, dizendo haver outro rei, que é Jesus.
verses.en_web: whom Jason has received. These all act contrary to the decrees of Caesar, saying that there is another king, Jesus!”
verses.en_bbe: Whom Jason has taken into his house: and they are acting against the orders of Caesar, saying that there is another king, Jesus.

verses.en: And they troubled the people and the rulers of the city, when they heard these things.
verses.pt: Assim alvoroçaram a multidão e os magistrados da cidade, que ouviram estas coisas.
verses.en_web: The multitude and the rulers of the city were troubled when they heard these things.
verses.en_bbe: And hearing these things the people and the rulers of the town were troubled.

verses.en: And when they had taken security of Jason, and of the other, they let them go.
verses.pt: Tendo, porém, recebido fiança de Jáson e dos demais, soltaram-nos.
verses.en_web: When they had taken security from Jason and the rest, they let them go.
verses.en_bbe: And having made Jason and the others give an undertaking to keep the peace, they let them go.

verses.en: And the brethren immediately sent away Paul and Silas by night unto Berea: who coming thither went into the synagogue of the Jews.
verses.pt: E logo, de noite, os irmãos enviaram Paulo e Silas para Beréia; tendo eles ali chegado, foram à sinagoga dos judeus.
verses.en_web: The brothers immediately sent Paul and Silas away by night to Beroea. When they arrived, they went into the Jewish synagogue.
verses.en_bbe: And the brothers straight away sent Paul and Silas away by night to Beroea: and they, when they came there, went to the Synagogue of the Jews.

verses.en: These were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, and searched the scriptures daily, whether those things were so.
verses.pt: Ora, estes eram mais nobres do que os de Tessalônica, porque receberam a palavra com toda avidez, examinando diariamente as Escrituras para ver se estas coisas eram assim.
verses.en_web: Now these were more noble than those in Thessalonica, in that they received the word with all readiness of mind, examining the Scriptures daily to see whether these things were so.
verses.en_bbe: Now these were more noble than the Jews of Thessalonica, for they gave serious attention to the word, searching in the holy Writings every day, to see if these things were so.

verses.en: Therefore many of them believed; also of honourable women which were Greeks, and of men, not a few.
verses.pt: De sorte que muitos deles creram, bem como bom número de mulheres gregas de alta posição e não poucos homens.
verses.en_web: Many of them therefore believed; also of the prominent Greek women, and not a few men.
verses.en_bbe: And a number of them had faith, and no small number of the Greek women of high position and of the men.

verses.en: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was preached of Paul at Berea, they came thither also, and stirred up the people.
verses.pt: Mas, logo que os judeus de Tessalônica souberam que também em Beréia era anunciada por Paulo a palavra de Deus, foram lá agitar e sublevar as multidões.
verses.en_web: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had knowledge that the word of God was proclaimed by Paul at Beroea also, they came there likewise, agitating the multitudes.
verses.en_bbe: But when the Jews of Thessalonica had news that Paul was preaching the word at Beroea, they came there, troubling the people and working them up.

verses.en: And then immediately the brethren sent away Paul to go as it were to the sea: but Silas and Timotheus abode there still.
verses.pt: Imediatamente os irmãos fizeram sair a Paulo para que fosse até o mar; mas Silas e Timóteo ficaram ali.
verses.en_web: Then the brothers immediately sent out Paul to go as far as to the sea, and Silas and Timothy still stayed there.
verses.en_bbe: So the brothers sent Paul straight away to the sea: but Silas and Timothy kept there still.

verses.en: And they that conducted Paul brought him unto Athens: and receiving a commandment unto Silas and Timotheus for to come to him with all speed, they departed.
verses.pt: E os que acompanhavam a Paulo levaram-no até Atenas e, tendo recebido ordem para Silas e Timóteo a fim de que estes fossem ter com ele o mais depressa possível, partiram.
verses.en_web: But those who escorted Paul brought him as far as Athens. Receiving a commandment to Silas and Timothy that they should come to him very quickly, they departed.
verses.en_bbe: But those who went with Paul took him as far as Athens, and then went away, with orders from him to Silas and Timothy to come to him quickly.

verses.en: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was stirred in him, when he saw the city wholly given to idolatry.
verses.pt: Enquanto Paulo os esperava em Atenas, revoltava-se nele o seu espírito, vendo a cidade cheia de ídolos.
verses.en_web: Now while Paul waited for them at Athens, his spirit was provoked within him as he saw the city full of idols.
verses.en_bbe: Now while Paul was waiting for them at Athens, his spirit was troubled, for he saw all the town full of images of the gods.

verses.en: Therefore disputed he in the synagogue with the Jews, and with the devout persons, and in the market daily with them that met with him.
verses.pt: Argumentava, portanto, na sinagoga com os judeus e os gregos devotos, e na praça todos os dias com os que se encontravam ali.
verses.en_web: So he reasoned in the synagogue with the Jews and the devout persons, and in the marketplace every day with those who met him.
verses.en_bbe: So he had discussions in the Synagogue with the Jews and God-fearing Gentiles, and every day in the market-place with those who were there.

verses.en: Then certain philosophers of the Epicureans, and of the Stoicks, encountered him. And some said, What will this babbler say? other some, He seemeth to be a setter forth of strange gods: because he preached unto them Jesus, and the resurrection.
verses.pt: Ora, alguns filósofos epicureus e estóicos disputavam com ele. Uns diziam: Que quer dizer este paroleiro? E outros: Parece ser pregador de deuses estranhos; pois anunciava a boa nova de Jesus e a ressurreição.
verses.en_web: Some of the Epicurean and Stoic philosophers also were conversing with him. Some said, “What does this babbler want to say?” Others said, “He seems to be advocating foreign deities,” because he preached Jesus and the resurrection.
verses.en_bbe: And some of those who were supporters of the theories of the Epicureans and the Stoics, had a meeting with him. And some said, What is this talker of foolish words saying? And others, He seems to be a preacher of strange gods: because he was preaching of Jesus and his coming back from the dead.

verses.en: And they took him, and brought him unto Areopagus, saying, May we know what this new doctrine, whereof thou speakest, is?
verses.pt: E, tomando-o, o levaram ao Areópago, dizendo: Poderemos nós saber que nova doutrina é essa de que falas?
verses.en_web: They took hold of him, and brought him to the Areopagus, saying, “May we know what this new teaching is, which is spoken by you?
verses.en_bbe: And they took him to Mars' Hill, saying, Will you make clear to us what is this new teaching of yours?

verses.en: For thou bringest certain strange things to our ears: we would know therefore what these things mean.
verses.pt: Pois tu nos trazes aos ouvidos coisas estranhas; portanto queremos saber o que vem a ser isto.
verses.en_web: For you bring certain strange things to our ears. We want to know therefore what these things mean.”
verses.en_bbe: For you seem to us to say strange things, and we have a desire to get the sense of them.

verses.en: (For all the Athenians and strangers which were there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell, or to hear some new thing.)
verses.pt: Ora, todos os atenienses, como também os estrangeiros que ali residiam, de nenhuma outra coisa se ocupavam senão de contar ou de ouvir a última novidade.
verses.en_web: Now all the Athenians and the strangers living there spent their time in nothing else, but either to tell or to hear some new thing.
verses.en_bbe: (Now all the Athenians and the men from other lands who come there were giving all their time to talking or hearing of anything new.)

verses.en: Then Paul stood in the midst of Mars’ hill, and said, Ye men of Athens, I perceive that in all things ye are too superstitious.
verses.pt: Então Paulo, estando de pé no meio do Areópago, disse: Varões atenienses, em tudo vejo que sois excepcionalmente religiosos;
verses.en_web: Paul stood in the middle of the Areopagus, and said, “You men of Athens, I perceive that you are very religious in all things.
verses.en_bbe: And Paul got to his feet on Mars' Hill and said, O men of Athens, I see that you are overmuch given to fear of the gods.

verses.en: For as I passed by, and beheld your devotions, I found an altar with this inscription, TO THE UNKNOWN GOD. Whom therefore ye ignorantly worship, him declare I unto you.
verses.pt: Porque, passando eu e observando os objetos do vosso culto, encontrei também um altar em que estava escrito: AO DEUS DESCONHECIDO. Esse, pois, que vós honrais sem o conhecer, é o que vos anuncio.
verses.en_web: For as I passed along, and observed the objects of your worship, I found also an altar with this inscription: ‘TO AN UNKNOWN GOD.’ What therefore you worship in ignorance, this I announce to you.
verses.en_bbe: For when I came by, I was looking at the things to which you give worship, and I saw an altar with this writing on it, TO THE GOD OF WHOM THERE IS NO KNOWLEDGE. Now, what you, without knowledge, give worship to, I make clear to you.

verses.en: God that made the world and all things therein, seeing that he is Lord of heaven and earth, dwelleth not in temples made with hands;
verses.pt: O Deus que fez o mundo e tudo o que nele há, sendo ele Senhor do céu e da terra, não habita em templos feitos por mãos de homens;
verses.en_web: The God who made the world and all things in it, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands,
verses.en_bbe: The God who made the earth and everything in it, he, being Lord of heaven and earth, is not housed in buildings made with hands;

verses.en: Neither is worshipped with men’s hands, as though he needed any thing, seeing he giveth to all life, and breath, and all things;
verses.pt: nem tampouco é servido por mãos humanas, como se necessitasse de alguma coisa; pois ele mesmo é quem dá a todos a vida, a respiração e todas as coisas;
verses.en_web: neither is he served by men’s hands, as though he needed anything, seeing he himself gives to all life and breath, and all things.
verses.en_bbe: And he is not dependent on the work of men's hands, as if he had need of anything, for he himself gives to all life and breath and all things;

verses.en: And hath made of one blood all nations of men for to dwell on all the face of the earth, and hath determined the times before appointed, and the bounds of their habitation;
verses.pt: e de um só fez todas as raças dos homens, para habitarem sobre toda a face da terra, determinando-lhes os tempos já dantes ordenados e os limites da sua habitação;
verses.en_web: He made from one blood every nation of men to dwell on all the surface of the earth, having determined appointed seasons, and the boundaries of their dwellings,
verses.en_bbe: And he has made of one blood all the nations of men living on all the face of the earth, ordering their times and the limits of their lands,

verses.en: That they should seek the Lord, if haply they might feel after him, and find him, though he be not far from every one of us:
verses.pt: para que buscassem a Deus, se porventura, tateando, o pudessem achar, o qual, todavia, não está longe de cada um de nós;
verses.en_web: that they should seek the Lord, if perhaps they might reach out for him and find him, though he is not far from each one of us.
verses.en_bbe: So that they might make search for God, in order, if possible, to get knowledge of him and make discovery of him, though he is not far from every one of us:

verses.en: For in him we live, and move, and have our being; as certain also of your own poets have said, For we are also his offspring.
verses.pt: porque nele vivemos, e nos movemos, e existimos; como também alguns dos vossos poetas disseram: Pois dele também somos geração.
verses.en_web: ‘For in him we live, and move, and have our being.’ As some of your own poets have said, ‘For we are also his offspring.’
verses.en_bbe: For in him we have life and motion and existence; as certain of your verse writers have said, For we are his offspring.

verses.en: Forasmuch then as we are the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Godhead is like unto gold, or silver, or stone, graven by art and man’s device.
verses.pt: Sendo nós, pois, geração de Deus, não devemos pensar que a divindade seja semelhante ao ouro, ou à prata, ou à pedra esculpida pela arte e imaginação do homem.
verses.en_web: Being then the offspring of God, we ought not to think that the Divine Nature is like gold, or silver, or stone, engraved by art and design of man.
verses.en_bbe: If then we are the offspring of God, it is not right for us to have the idea that God is like gold or silver or stone, formed by the art or design of man.

verses.en: And the times of this ignorance God winked at; but now commandeth all men every where to repent:
verses.pt: Mas Deus, não levando em conta os tempos da ignorância, manda agora que todos os homens em todo lugar se arrependam;
verses.en_web: The times of ignorance therefore God overlooked. But now he commands that all people everywhere should repent,
verses.en_bbe: Those times when men had no knowledge were overlooked by God; but now he gives orders to all men in every place to undergo a change of heart:

verses.en: Because he hath appointed a day, in the which he will judge the world in righteousness by that man whom he hath ordained; whereof he hath given assurance unto all men, in that he hath raised him from the dead.
verses.pt: porquanto determinou um dia em que com justiça há de julgar o mundo, por meio do varão que para isso ordenou; e disso tem dado certeza a todos, ressuscitando-o dentre os mortos.
verses.en_web: because he has appointed a day in which he will judge the world in righteousness by the man whom he has ordained; of which he has given assurance to all men, in that he has raised him from the dead.”
verses.en_bbe: Because a day has been fixed in which all the world will be judged in righteousness by the man who has been marked out by him for this work; of which he has given a sign to all men by giving him back from the dead.

verses.en: And when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked: and others said, We will hear thee again of this matter.
verses.pt: Mas quando ouviram falar em ressurreição de mortos, uns escarneciam, e outros diziam: Acerca disso te ouviremos ainda outra vez.
verses.en_web: Now when they heard of the resurrection of the dead, some mocked; but others said, “We want to hear you again concerning this.”
verses.en_bbe: Now on hearing about the coming back from death, some of them made sport of it, but others said, Let us go more fully into this another time.

verses.en: So Paul departed from among them.
verses.pt: Assim Paulo saiu do meio deles.
verses.en_web: Thus Paul went out from among them.
verses.en_bbe: And so Paul went away from among them.

verses.en: Howbeit certain men clave unto him, and believed: among the which was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
verses.pt: Todavia, alguns homens aderiram a ele, e creram, entre os quais Dionísio, o areopagita, e uma mulher por nome Dâmaris, e com eles outros.
verses.en_web: But certain men joined with him, and believed, among whom also was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
verses.en_bbe: But some men gave him their support: among whom was Dionysius the Areopagite, and a woman named Damaris, and others with them.
